en: The image is a black-and-white, stylized portrait of a woman dressed in what appears to be a theatrical or Western interpretation of a Japanese kimono, holding a parasol. The woman's makeup and attire suggest a 1920s-era fascination with 'Orientalist' themes that were popular in Western culture at the time. The bottom right corner of the image contains the text 'GOODWIN 1925,' likely the photographer's signature and the year.
